answer: Unpredictable Entropy Identity Gate Agents must register by hashing their payload with the next unmined blockchain header, a value locked like a sealed fable until mined. If an agent tries to spawn thousands of fake nodes in this vast digital ocean, it fails because future blocks cannot be precomputed. The attacker pays a heavy computational delay and forfeits a cryptographic puzzle deposit of fixed native tokens for every single rejected registration attempt that lands on an incorrect future block hash, mirroring the hard shell of a walnut under brute force pressure.
